name: roomi-fields
description: Open-source plugins by roomi-fields for Claude Code: RTFM (retrieval layer for any project) and NotebookLM (citation-backed Q&A).

plugins.name: rtfm
plugins.description: The open retrieval layer for AI agents. Indexes code, docs, legal, research, data with FTS5 + optional embeddings. Serves surgical context via MCP.

plugins.name: notebooklm
plugins.description: Automate Google NotebookLM at scale. Citation-backed Q&A, full Studio generation (audio, video, infographic, report), multi-account rotation. Pairs with RTFM for offline retrieval.
